title: Thai Chicken Skewers
description: Grilled chicken skewers with Thai-inspired flavors, served with a side of sticky rice.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together curry paste, honey, soy sauce, fish sauce, and grated ginger. Add chicken and mix until coated.
3. Thread chicken onto bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush grill grates with unsalted butter to prevent sticking.
5. Grill chicken for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
6. Brush with additional butter during last 2 minutes of grilling.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with sticky rice.
